page.overview:
Who is Dash?

Dash is a character appearing in . She is the doppelgänger of Dot and therefore resembles her.

Her Japanese name, ボッコ Bokko, comes from a pattern-based respelling of ドット Dotto, officially romanized "Dot".

Her English dub name, Dash, comes from the word "dash". It starts with the same letter as Dot, and forms a possible reference to Morse code when combined (dots and dashes).

In Latin American Spanish, she is called Doki, a reference to [https://doki.fandom.com/es/wiki/Doki Doki], a character from the Latin American TV channel [https://discovery-kids.fandom.com/es/wiki/Discovery_Kids_(Latinoam%C3%A9rica) Discovery Kids], who appeared as the mascot from [https://youtu.be/ApFndzbnk_w?si=ciugoNZzXeKodzTi 2005] to [https://youtu.be/bylu43XYnHQ?si=MWjqLh6s7lcWLKJi 2019] and had his own animated series in [https://youtu.be/_mJbLx4lvsI?si=ORCk6KB7FJu3isMs 2013].
